name: @ycet/dsh-account-usage
description: DeepSeek Harness web-GUI plugin: merges a DeepSeek platform balance/usage page into the official settings「账号与余额」page (daily cost chart, per-model requests & tokens, web search/fetch call type usage, selectable time range), with a fallback account section when the official page is unavailable, an account-menu balance entry, the OpenCode Go 5h/weekly/monthly quota with reset times, and a per-day quota-consumption trend with a linear end-of-period forecast (local 15-minute sampling, optionally upgraded to the official OpenCode Console daily report via a session cookie).
author: Ycet

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/aggregate.js
